goal: Write 1 Q&A per pillar across 10 pillars, 1 at a time, repeat 250 cycles then stop.
dedup_verify_note: IMPORTANT: the Jaccard dedup checker over-flags shared template boilerplate. The REAL test is whether the specific topic/industry word already exists - grep the live library-list for that word in the pillar prefix before writing (e.g. restaurant ik0401 existed but was hidden behind boilerplate matches). Used so far - ik: hvac/dental/law-firm/funeral-home. tk: med-spa/pest-control/landscaping/self-storage. ra: vertical-saas/plg/professional-services/insurance-agency. st: objections/discovery/cold-calling/multithreading. bs: gap-selling/spin/never-split-the-difference/fanatical-prospecting. er: headsets/webcams/laptops/earbuds. fr: tropical-smoothie/crumbl/daves-hot-chicken/spavia. gp: usage-pricing/mid-to-enterprise/product-line-launch/international. q: forecast-model/comp-plans/sales-cycle/sales-marketing-alignment. nil: texas/duke/lsu/uconn-wbb. RECOVERY: if state stale, recompute next IDs from live library-list max per prefix.
banned_word_note: The word 'landscape' is BANNED and trips even on org names (e.g. National Association of Landscape Professionals). Avoid it entirely. Other banned: delve, tapestry, holistic, in today's, ever-evolving, synergy, paradigm shift, game-changer, cutting-edge, state-of-the-art, seamless integration, drive growth, unlock, needless to say, it's worth noting, it's important to note.
dedup_note: Run _marathon_dedup.js <prefix> for non-q entries; _economy_q_dedupe_check.js for q/nil. Template-boilerplate matches across industries are NOT dups; same-topic+same-year IS (e.g. Jersey Mike's fr0006 exists). fr pillar deep (620+) - pick less-common real franchises.
recipe: Pre-grade every draft with node -e gradeEntry before publishing. Floor pillars need DENSE prose (grader counts ~0.65x of visual length): ra/gp/er=1800, ik/bs/st=1500, q/tk/fr=1100. KPI(ik) needs BOTH a TL;DR blockquote AND a Direct Answer header. st has a HARD reject below 1500. er needs 10 numbered product H2s + both BEST OVERALL + BEST VALUE pills. Every entry: 2 mermaids (er=1+), FAQ 4+, Sources 5+, 3+ named companies, no banned phrases, review-keyword footer line. Topics framed 2027.
notes: Floor pillars (ra/gp/er=1800, ik/bs/st=1500) count raw tokens incl mermaid/markdown; write ~1900/1600 tokens to clear cleanly. KPI needs a Direct Answer header in addition to TL;DR. st has a HARD floor gate. fr indexnow ping 404s (not whitelisted) but entry publishes fine.
